name: Sharka Grossmanova
original_name: シャールカ・グロスマノヴァ
source: The lazy upperclassman who is a member of the Charity Club. She is always laying on the couch playing games and just lazing around. Despite this, Sharka gets unbelievably good results from the tests which are considered one of the best in the nation.
